text: The Patriots fell short in a Thursday Night Football matchup against the Bears, dropping a 30-24 contest in Chicago as Caleb Williams outdueled Drake Maye with two touchdown passes to secure the victory for Round 2 against New England. The game proved costly on the offensive line, as starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown were ruled out with injuries, forcing adjustments up front that the Patriots couldn't fully overcome. On the bright side, running back Rhamondre Stevenson posted a career-high in receiving yards and continues to do the little things right, putting him on track to reach 100 carries for the sixth consecutive season despite the loss. Head Coach Mike Vrabel and his players addressed the defeat in postgame remarks, with plenty of film to review as the team looks to bounce back from a TNF defeat that slipped away in the final moments.
